motion.scope: Actual Gazebo ground-truth poses/speeds. Each corner includes its 60cm approach (90cm for the broad final bend) through five consecutive samples within the original 0.025rad final-heading tolerance, including any moving/stopped recognition. No cutting at OBSERVE onset. Stops >=0.25s below 0.02m/s; required recognition/light/parking remains visible.

path_speed.scope: Ground-truth speed and centre error are read-only evaluation. Same 60cm corner windows, GO samples over 3cm/s; required stops excluded for both versions. Stress/dim/dynamic still satisfy centre/safety/command limits; minimum normal cruise-speed gates apply only to normal mapping, saved-map, packaged-map and repeat laps.

planning_grid.source: SLAM OccupancyGrid, >=3-frame endpoints and unique-per-frame clear rays registered by camera/wheel/IMU source-time TF; clear requires >=3 frames and >=3 clear votes per hit; supplied lanes separately constrain travel; no SDF collision coordinates

mapping.source: Fresh SLAM Toolbox mapping process, actual /scan and wheel/camera/IMU localization; no previously saved SLAM grid loaded
mapping.autonomy: Known competition route drives the robot; human teleoperation and ground truth are absent from mapping control
mapping.scope: Known-field autonomous route mapping, not unknown-environment frontier exploration; supplied lane geometry is disclosed separately

scope: Eight real Gazebo laps, frozen runtime. Known supplied gallery and lane prior; no claim of hardware or unknown-world/general-person recognition or persistent-blockage detours. Failed attempts retained. No footage acceleration.
changed_contracts: Ordinary transit waypoint completion is measured plane passage with at most 2cm lateral error, instead of stopping in the former 8mm circle; semantic observation/light/final tolerances retained.
Continuous path coverage checks all17 waypoints within2mm and semantic endpoints within2mm; an ordinary transit waypoint need not be a separate Nav2 endpoint.
Full-turn windows include actual motion through final-heading convergence, including OBSERVE frames. Previous plate-entry truncation at OBSERVE is not used as complete-turn proof.

Planned 2mm long-straight metric applies after the certified initial centre join; old whole-window error is also retained. Actual straight2cm, source coverage98%, localization6cm, post5cm, vision8Hz and p95image150ms unchanged.
